name: Chroma MCP Server
summary: Official Chroma MCP server for collections, semantic search and memory. Apache-2.0; local uvx or Cloud client; last pushed 2025-09-17.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Chroma). https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma-mcp is Apache-2.0, not archived, created 2025-02-11 and last pushed 2025-09-17T20:20:13Z (2025-09-17 22:20:13 Europe/Stockholm) — that last-push date is more than a year before this review and is disclosed. Official docs remain at https://docs.trychroma.com/integrations/frameworks/anthropic-mcp (HTTP 200) and describe the Chroma MCP server. The README states this is an MCP server for self-hosting access to Chroma (not the separate Package Search repo). Client types: ephemeral (in-memory), persistent (file-based), HTTP for a self-hosted Chroma instance, and a Cloud client that official docs say automatically connects to api.trychroma.com. Tools include collection create/list/modify/delete and document add, query, get, update, and delete. Documented embedding functions include default, cohere, openai, jina, voyageai, and roboflow; external embedding APIs need their own keys, which were not supplied. Documented `uvx chroma-mcp` / Claude Desktop config was not executed. Host trust: the default documented setups run on the operator's machine or against a self-hosted or Chroma Cloud instance you configure; collection delete and document write tools can change that store. Chroma Cloud or third-party embedding usage, if any, is separate and was not purchased. Related catalog entry chroma covers the database product and did not set an mcp_endpoint. No signup or spend.

agent_access.notes: No public hosted MCP URL is documented as a default endpoint; official setup uses a local uvx/stdio (or similar) server, optionally with a Cloud client to api.trychroma.com. The uvx command and Claude Desktop config were not run. Public docs and the GitHub repo need no login. Last GitHub push was 2025-09-17.
